Ivy Tran: Concordia Labs wants a quick POC to validate throughput + tail stability. Target: 2k sustained req/s for smart-summaries, with two 20s spikes at +180% during a 20m hold. They expect p95 < 220ms for ~140-token responses. Need plan + 1mo/3mo committed pricing by tomorrow afternoon.

Diego Alvarez: Quick clarifiers: is 2k mostly short generation? Any embedded search or long-form pieces? Also confirm model family (they mentioned "open-30B-ish").

Ivy Tran: Buyer replied: ~88% short (120-160 tokens), 10% medium (300 tokens), 2% embeddings. Model family: open-30B derivative.

Mala Reddy: Proposed test: 10m ramp to 2k, 20m steady, inject two 20s spikes at +180% spaced 7m apart, then cool down. Capture p50/p90/p95/p99, error rate, throughput heatmap, and GPU/host metrics. Pin model hash and disable background warmups to get reproducible numbers.

Diego Alvarez: Runner snippet (pseudo):
```
loadtest --url https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --rate 2000 --duration 00:40:00 \ 
  --spikes "20s:+180%@12m,20s:+180%@19m" --body samples/concordia_prompts.json \ 
  --hdr "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --out artifacts/concordia-6112343210
```

Mala Reddy: Ops note: for p95 <220ms during spikes Dedicated with pinned pool is recommended. Hosted on-demand may meet avg latency but tails vulnerable to noisy neighbors. Recommend route splitting for medium requests to avoid KV cache pollution.

SecEng: Security checklist: customer-managed keys (CMK) supported on Dedicated via KMS proxy; HSM/BYOK requires Private and longer lead time. We can provide SOC2 attestation and log-forwarding options; ask them for SIEM endpoint and residency requirement.

Billing: For pricing we need expected token mix (prompt vs completion) and avg tokens per request. Also confirm whether they want burst credits included in committed pricing.

Ivy Tran: Buyer answered token mix: prompt ~50 tokens, completion ~90 tokens on avg => ~140 tokens total. They want burst credits.

Diego Alvarez: Back-of-envelope: 2k * 140 tokens = 280k tokens/s. For open 30B FP16 with KV cache and batching we estimate 2-3 A100-equivalents steady; with 4-bit quant maybe 2. I'll run a quick sim tonight and post GPU-seconds and a latency CDF by 10am PT tomorrow.

perf-runner-bot: scheduled: concordia-poc-6112345000 (runner: perf-small-1).

Mala Reddy: Runbook: reserve stage Dedicated pool min=2 max=5; enable prefix KV cache; set autoscale quick-path for burst; separate medium-route pool if memory pressure observed. Alert thresholds: p95>300ms or error-rate>0.5%.

Ivy Tran: Action items:
- Diego: perf sim + GPU sizing (deliver by 10am PT)
- Mala: reserve pool & draft runbook (EOD)
- SecEng: draft security answers for hosted/dedicated/private (EOD)
- Billing: prepare 1mo & 3mo committed quotes including burst credits + hosted on-demand estimate (after Diego numbers)

Diego Alvarez: Kicking off sim now. Will pin model and use deterministic decoding for stability.

perf-runner-bot: run started concordia-poc-6112345000 (ETA ~30m).

Ivy Tran: Scheduling a 30m alignment with Concordia for tomorrow 9:30am PT. Will attach prompts and questionnaire.

Billing: Once Diego posts sizing I'll draft pricing options and include a short note: "why Dedicated reduces tail exposure" for procurement.

SecEng: Also ask buyer if they need audit log retention beyond default retention window; that'll affect the answer.

Mala Reddy: If sim shows tail spikes during bursts, plan is to increase min pool size and enable pre-warm hooks.

Ivy Tran: Thanks team 680. Any blockers?

Diego Alvarez: None, running now.

perf-runner-bot: run complete concordia-poc-6112345000 (artifacts uploaded).
